description: This file contains functions for interacting with the LEDs on an OpenWrt device, including retrieving LED paths, setting LED attributes, and controlling LED behaviors such as blinking, turning on/off, and restoring default triggers.

methods.name: get_dt_led_path
methods.description: Retrieves the device tree LED path for a specified LED identifier.

methods.name: get_dt_led_color_func
methods.description: Determines the color or function name of a LED based on device tree attributes.

methods.name: get_dt_led
methods.description: Gets the label/name of a LED based on device tree or fallback methods.

methods.name: led_set_attr
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute of a LED, such as brightness or trigger.

methods.name: led_timer
methods.description: Configures a LED to blink with specified on and off delays.

methods.name: led_on
methods.description: Turns a LED on by setting brightness to maximum.

methods.name: led_off
methods.description: Turns a LED off by setting brightness to zero.

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the default trigger for a status LED from device tree.

methods.name: status_led_set_timer
methods.description: Sets the status LED to blink with specified delays.

methods.name: status_led_set_heartbeat
methods.description: Sets the status LED to heartbeat mode.

methods.name: status_led_blink_slow
methods.description: Configures the status LEDs to blink slowly.

methods.name: status_led_blink_fast
methods.description: Configures the status LEDs to blink quickly.

methods.name: status_led_blink_preinit_regular
methods.description: Sets a regular pre-init blinking pattern.
